channels.title: Payment channels
channels.description: Manage WeChat Pay, Alipay, and PayPal channel accounts.
channels.name: Name
channels.invalidConfig: Channel config must be valid JSON.
channels.formDescription: Fill fields by channel type. Empty sensitive fields keep the current value.
channels.keepSecretPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep current value
channels.secretEditHint: Empty sensitive fields keep the current value; entering a new value replaces it.
channels.wechatConfigHint: WeChat Pay v3 config: app_id, mch_id, api_v3_key, serial_no, private_key, wechat_pay_public_key, wechat_pay_public_key_id, and terminal-aware capabilities. WeChat Pay API v3 has no separate sandbox endpoint.
channels.alipayConfigHint: Alipay v3 config: app_id, private_key, alipay_public_key, server_url, and terminal-aware capabilities.
channels.paypalConfigHint: PayPal config: client_id, client_secret, webhook_id, brand_name, intent, and locale. Only CAPTURE is currently supported.

placeholders.name: Example: WeChat Pay production merchant

hints.app_id: Application identifier assigned by the payment provider.
hints.api_v3_key: WeChat Pay API v3 key for callbacks and signing.
hints.private_key: Merchant private key for request signing.
hints.wechat_pay_public_key: WeChat Pay platform public key for callback verification.
hints.wechat_pay_public_key_id: WeChat Pay public key ID. Keep the PUB_KEY_ID_ prefix when public-key verification is enabled.
hints.alipay_public_key: Used to verify Alipay responses and callbacks.
hints.server_url: Alipay API gateway URL. Use sandbox gateway for sandbox.
hints.product_code: Alipay product code. The SDK usually uses FAST_INSTANT_TRADE_PAY for page pay.
hints.enable_native_pay: Use WeChat Native QR pay when checkout is opened from a desktop browser.
hints.enable_h5_pay: Prefer WeChat H5 pay when checkout is opened from a mobile browser.
hints.enable_page_pay: Use Alipay page pay when checkout is opened from a desktop browser.
hints.enable_wap_pay: Prefer Alipay WAP pay when checkout is opened from a mobile browser.
hints.enable_qr_pay: Allow QR fallback when mobile WAP pay is unavailable, and as desktop fallback.
hints.webhook_id: PayPal Webhook ID for event verification.
hints.brand_name: Merchant brand name shown on PayPal checkout.
hints.intent: The current payment completion flow only supports CAPTURE.
hints.locale: Locale used by the PayPal checkout page.

routing.title: Channel routing
routing.description: Route checkout payments by app, currency, amount, and terminal.
routing.formDescription: Rules match from high to low priority. Checkout falls back to available channels only when no rules exist.
routing.basicInfoHint: App scope, currency, amount, terminal, and payment method decide whether a rule matches.

sections.identityDescription: Name, order, and activation state for this matching rule.
sections.matchDescription: Checkout filters rules by app, terminal, amount, and payment method.

summary.title: Rule preview
summary.description: A live summary generated from the current form.

configGuide.title: Configuration guide
configGuide.description: Define match conditions first, then target concrete channel accounts.
configGuide.priority: Higher rule priority matches first. Higher target priority is selected first.
configGuide.scope: App, currency, amount, terminal, and payment method all participate in matching.
configGuide.amount: Amounts use minor units. Example: 9900 means 99.00.
configGuide.mode: Enter one mode per line: WeChat native/h5/jsapi, Alipay page/wap/qr, PayPal checkout.

hints.name: Give this route a clear, recognizable name.
hints.appScope: All apps means no app limit. Selected apps requires app IDs.
hints.appIds: Use one app ID per line or separate with commas.
hints.currency: Leave empty to match every currency.
hints.minAmount: Use 0 to remove the minimum amount limit.
hints.maxAmount: Use 0 to remove the maximum amount limit.
hints.paymentMethod: The user-facing payment method on checkout.
hints.payModes: Use one pay mode per line or separate with commas. Empty means no limit.
hints.enabled: Disable the rule to remove it from matching.

targets.title: Target channel accounts
targets.description: A rule can target multiple channel accounts under the same payment method.
targets.emptyDescription: There are no channel accounts for the selected payment method. Configure one in Payment channels first.
